thesis: Hydroblast gives blue decks an equally efficient answer to red spells and permanents, often trading one mana for the format’s fastest threats or prison pieces.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Hydroblast became a defining anti-red sideboard card in Eternal and Pauper play, mirroring Pyroblast while reflecting the long history of color-hate interaction.
